question: The annual growth rate of consumer confidence index from 2000 to 2008
query: SELECT      current_year.year AS year,     ((current_value.consumer_confidence_index - previous_value.consumer_confidence_index) / previous_value.consumer_confidence_index) * 100 AS growth_rate FROM      (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year, consumer_confidence_index      FROM finance_economics_dataset      ORDER BY date      LIMIT 50) AS current_value JOIN      (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year, consumer_confidence_index      FROM finance_economics_dataset      ORDER BY date      LIMIT 50) AS previous_value ON current_value.year = previous_value.year - 1 WHERE current_value.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2008 LIMIT 50;
